s05065.summary: Ines films as Lorna and Walt begin sorting their late mother's storage unit.
Walt and Lorna trade memories over records and a child's shoe, softening old disputes.
They choose to keep the shoe, the dress and the Singer, then linger in silence.

s05067.summary: Retired driver Hal finds his minivan overfull with strange passengers and a fogged, unknown road.
Ivo says they must pass the gate by sunrise because the girl is the key.
Dev's mother texts and Sorcha tells him not to answer until the border.
White light rises through the floor and the road becomes a stone staircase into a lantern valley.

s05069.summary: In the studio control room, Reggie replays a vocal take while a late email sits on Kat's laptop.
Omar argues Shay's take isn't the one for the record, citing money.
Kat discloses the wire and that Omar secretly owns the masters Shay signed away.
Shay asks if it is true, Omar justifies it as business, and she sets down her headphones.
Thunder breaks, Omar blocks the door forbidding copies, and Shay presses record.

s05070.summary: Maya scans parcels late at night in a rainy warehouse, texting friend Bee.
Joss arrives and sits oddly quiet; Maya notices he holds his phone like a grenade.
Joss shows a chat with her photo; Bee enters with a birthday cake and Maya laughs and cries.

s05071.summary: Sam and Mo trade deadpan jokes and crisps on a slowing night bus in the snow.
The bus halts in a white nothing; the driver goes out to radio in.
They joke about taking turns being warm; Sam admires Mo's coat and Mo throws a crisp.
The driver returns snow-covered and everyone settles in to wait in the quiet.

s05072.summary: Captain Pip warns the crab and seagull away from the net as the boat bobs at dawn.
Ollie the lantern senses the humming sea while Nina serves cocoa.
Bubbles rise and something huge approaches; Pip decides to say hello as the water swells.

s05073.summary: Shaking Ash holds a knife on a stranger who entered through a locked back door.
Delphine introduces herself as a lab survivor and offers explanation; Ash lowers the knife.
The radio warns of someone at the window; Ash demands the whole story.

s05074.summary: Tim and Tom sit sulking in a deserted wedding hall, trading stilted remarks.
Hattie presses them about a medal; Tom accuses Tim of throwing the baton years ago.
Tim and Tom agree to take it outside; Hattie shrugs as bins crash.

s05075.summary: A rideshare driver chats with sleepy twins on camera during a 2 a.m. drive.
The twins reveal their mother is in labor; Priya teaches them her name for safety.
At the hospital the twins run to their father; Priya signs off with congratulations.

s05076.summary: A touring band hands over four passports all reading Gary; the guard is unamused.
The guard asks about the drummer and spots a dog in sunglasses in the van.
Walt sends the dog to quarantine and drops the gate; the vending machine drops soup.

s05077.summary: Kip brings Kim tea in a silent office and notices an external upload.
Kip calls the upload theft; Kim says it is leverage and the team turns.
Kip leads the team out, then shows Kim a text meant for him, paling her.

s05078_0.summary: Protesters march on a dusty road as Tess locks herself into concrete and Cole arrives.

s05078_1.summary: Dana, Rosa, Eli and Tess argue with Cole over land, drought and a signed order.
Cole orders the sheriff to arrest the barrel; the crowd surges until sirens and dust approach.

s05079.summary: New receptionist June flusters through check-in with River and their dog Biscuit.
A cat escapes, the fish tank spills, and a drenched man with a parrot demands the boss.

s05080.summary: Court-ordered Tess sits alone in an empty church basement on a rainy night.
A soaked woman storms in claiming Tess's chair; they learn nobody else is coming.
Tess tries to leave; Greta shares her story and Tess sits and introduces herself.

s05083.summary: Priya sits with Jaylen, buried in a group chat over a damaging screenshot, and jokes him along.
Lawyer Ms. Adeyemi arrives, moves the deposition, and tells Jaylen to start from the beginning.

s05084.summary: Three group chat strangers meet in a diner and introduce their handles.
Theo admits he invented his church story because he wanted someone to message back.
Maya and Desmond accept Theo, share his fries and order more as the chat lights up.

s05085_0.summary: Bridget and Garrett wait in a magical fertility clinic where Dr. Plum introduces a dragon.

s05085_1.summary: Dr. Plum announces magical test results with a small curse, a Hex of Perpetual Maybe.
Dr. Plum proposes a gentle exorcism and shoos away the dragon Kevin.

s05086.summary: Big Dave, Mo, Jen and goblin Sam work a frantic food truck kitchen.
Mrs. K calls to complain about the line, free pickles and Mo's slow chopping.
Dave ignores Sam's warning; the fryer ignites, Jen hangs up and Dave douses the kitchen in foam.

s05089.summary: Lin sets up a video about a haunted fountain; nervous Kofi questions it.
Park-goers vanish, the video glitches, and a figure appears in the fountain only on screen.
Lin shuts the phone off and leaves quickly with Kofi, never looking back.

s05090.summary: Gordon flounders through clinic forms; his wife's call reveals he left the sample in a hot car.
A motionless woman in sunglasses opens her coat to reveal the cooler bag strapped to her.
Gordon lunges, Halloran joins, and all crash into the pamphlet rack.
The woman is Bev, Rosalind's sister, who confesses stealing it was freelance; Tess asks about the co-pay.

s05091.summary: Juno waits at her station as a still hooded figure stands behind her and the loading bar stalls.
The crowd goes silent, Dev warns Juno away from the screen, and the monitors type a message.
Two unmoving twins appear; the pit blacks out and only empty headsets remain.

s05092.summary: In 1923, Margaret and cold Edmund hear the doctor discuss their childlessness.
The doctor states there is no fault in Margaret and the laboratory results blame Edmund.
Edmund rages and knocks the tray down; Sister Brigid threatens to call the porters.
Edmund takes his hat and leaves; Margaret is offered tea and rest.

s05095.summary: Sage slides into Tobias's booth and deadpans about a stolen casserole dish and eleven suspects.
Sage shows a message that Linda found the dish in her oven and makes Tobias pay.

s05096_0.summary: At the funeral reception, Vic presses widow Nora about the will.
A distorted caller warns Nora about the study; Vic heads for the hallway and runs.

s05096_1.summary: A door slams in the hallway.
